IMG_2285.HEIC.title: Beach: resort and restaurant frontage
IMG_2285.HEIC.observation: View from the pebble-strewn beach toward the white resort and beach restaurant frontage, with palms and seaward terraces. Useful for broad building silhouettes and the sand/stone mix; no restaurant footprint or beach elevation is measured here.

IMG_2286.HEIC.title: Elena junction: side-by-side ramp and steps
IMG_2286.HEIC.observation: Close view of a terracotta approach with a smooth sloping strip beside a flight of shallow steps, low white edging, and a transverse drain at the foot. Clipped hedge, blue flowers and a partially visible Elena plaque identify the junction. The separate steps are visible evidence not yet matched to detailed game geometry.

IMG_2287.HEIC.title: Elena junction: private doorway and planting
IMG_2287.HEIC.observation: A private brown timber door sits above small tiled entrance steps behind a low white planting wall. Blue flowers and bougainvillea screen white plaster fronts; a tall black lantern and flush utility cover are visible. Private door steps are distinct from the shared junction ramp.

IMG_2288.HEIC.title: Cervantes area: passage signed Calle Miguel
IMG_2288.HEIC.observation: Inside a covered walk-through with a visible CALLE MIGUEL plaque. Red square tiles with small decorative inserts, black hanging lanterns, barred windows, potted plants and an arch opening onto a narrow planted lane are visible. The plaque is observed; association with the full mapped Miguel de Cervantes name needs review.

IMG_2289.HEIC.title: Cervantes exit: white-edged tiled approach
IMG_2289.HEIC.observation: Looking toward the roadside hedge over a terracotta approach bounded by low white walls and planting. A drain crosses the lower end and a black lantern stands at the corner. The shape and planting support the entrance reference; the image alone does not measure its rise.

IMG_2290.HEIC.title: Pintor Dalí: grass between bays and shared footpath
IMG_2290.HEIC.observation: A parked car and white bay markings sit beside a grass strip with broad-leaved planting. A separate terracotta house-side footpath and white plaster frontages are behind the grass. Confirms the surface order; widths remain estimated.

IMG_2291.HEIC.title: Pintor Dalí: arched entrance and white facade
IMG_2291.HEIC.observation: Frontal view of a two-storey white building with an arched ground-level opening, rounded plaster balcony edge, timber shutters, barred window and lantern. The terracotta house-side footpath runs between the facade and a narrow lawn/parking edge.

IMG_2292.HEIC.title: Pintor Dalí: continuous tiled footpath and lawns
IMG_2292.HEIC.observation: Oblique view along white two-storey frontages, the shared terracotta path, narrow grass strip and asphalt bays. Arched openings, black window grilles, small balconies and planting divide the frontage. Useful for proportions and surface continuity.

IMG_2293.HEIC.title: Pintor Dalí: lane entrance, ramp and drain
IMG_2293.HEIC.observation: A terracotta entrance slopes from the parking area into a narrow lane between white patio walls and dense planting. A green drain/service grate is at the foot and a tall traditional black lantern stands at the corner. Lane name is not visible; do not assume this is Cervantes.

IMG_2294.HEIC.title: Dalí seaward end: flagstone approach to arch
IMG_2294.HEIC.observation: Pale irregular flagstone paving leads through an arched covered passage. Flared low white curbs, clipped hedges, blue flowers and climbing plants frame the approach. Stone paving is distinct from the square-tiled entrances elsewhere.

IMG_2295.HEIC.title: Dalí seaward end: covered access and shutters
IMG_2295.HEIC.observation: Second view of the flagstone approach and arched passage, showing the tiled canopy, dark louvred shutters, side balcony and planting. Corroborates IMG_2294; it is not independent measurement of the passage dimensions.

IMG_2296.HEIC.title: Dalí seaward end: parking turn and coast boundary
IMG_2296.HEIC.observation: View around the widened asphalt end area toward a low white wall and metal fence by the sea. Yellow curb paint, white bay lines, red-and-white post, a no-parking sign, palms and flowering planting identify the coastal turn.

IMG_2297.HEIC.title: Dalí seaward end: narrow pedestrian gate
IMG_2297.HEIC.observation: A narrow dark metal pedestrian gate sits beside a white pier, rigid metal mesh on a low white plinth to the left, and a taller solid white wall to the right. A modern slim lamp, yellow curb paint and a no-parking sign identify the asphalt parking end. The wall/mesh/gate arrangement is now represented in the structural model; plan position, gate width and wall heights remain estimates.
IMG_2297.HEIC.visualReview: Compared with structural wall/mesh/gate model; arrangement represented, plan position and dimensions remain estimates

IMG_2298.HEIC.title: Beach: white seaward houses and palm
IMG_2298.HEIC.observation: Beach-level view back toward two-storey white homes, dark shutters, a palm and the low coast boundary. Sand and scattered pebbles fill the foreground. This camera position is shared with the next two differently directed views.

IMG_2299.HEIC.title: Beach: houses along the shore
IMG_2299.HEIC.observation: Oblique beach view along the row of white seaward houses and palms, with a pebbled sandy foreground and distant coastline. Useful for the coastline-side silhouette and texture; individual house positions are not determined from this view.

IMG_2300.HEIC.title: Beach: pebbles, sand and distant coastline
IMG_2300.HEIC.observation: Wide view along the beach with mixed sand, stones and rounded pebbles, the sea to the right and low buildings beyond. Provides a stronger ground-material reference than a uniform pale-sand texture.

IMG_2360.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking east-north-east along Cervantes
IMG_2360.HEIC.observation: From a roof terrace beside Calle Elena, looking roughly along the line of Cervantes. Below: courtyard walls with magenta bougainvillea, a patio with a timber pergola, arched first-floor windows, a wooden balcony under a small barrel-tile roof and iron balconies. Beyond: flat roofs with solar panels, the long apartment block, a tall palm and the sea at the right. Camera on a roof, so the pin sits inside a registry building.

IMG_2361.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking down into a gated tiled entry
IMG_2361.HEIC.observation: Looking south-west down over barrel roof tiles into a narrow entry between two-storey houses: patterned terracotta floor tiles, a pair of black iron gates in a white gateway topped with bougainvillea, a small first-floor balcony and an arched opening with lantern beyond. Gives the width and enclosure of the entry from above; dimensions are not measured. Camera on the roof of the covered-passage building (registry part 6265201UF1366N_part5).

IMG_2362.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking east-south-east over the terraces to the sea
IMG_2362.HEIC.observation: Over lichen-mottled barrel roof tiles and a tall magnolia-like hedge: a wooden balcony with a tiled canopy, iron balconies with arched shuttered doors, flat roofs with solar panels and chimneys, a Norfolk pine, palms, and the sea on the horizon. Good for roofscape and facade detail.

IMG_2363.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking down the lane to the north pool lawn gate
IMG_2363.HEIC.observation: Looking almost straight down from a roof edge, north-north-west: a narrow square-tiled terracotta lane between white walls with a planted strip, private patios behind low walls with brown doors, and an arched white garden gateway with bougainvillea that opens onto crazy paving and the north pool lawn (bollard lights, palm, tree). Shows how the Elena north lane meets the north pool courtyard.

6E090F77-BFAF-46F8-A753-0388F6BD1DB5.jpg.title: Beach: pebbles on sand at the water line
6E090F77-BFAF-46F8-A753-0388F6BD1DB5.jpg.observation: Wide 16:9 image of the beach at the water line: coarse grey-brown sand with scattered dark rounded pebbles, a denser pebble band along the shore, small breaking waves and a kite-surfer far out. No location data in the file, so it is unplaced; which stretch of beach it shows is not confirmed.

IMG_2345.HEIC.title: Pintor Picasso: service road, utility sheds and bins
IMG_2345.HEIC.observation: Looking north-west up the asphalt service road off Calle Pintor Picasso. Left: a dark slatted fence, then low white utility sheds with brown doors and a meter box, then a long plain white boundary wall. Right: a low white building on a rough stone plinth with black tubular railings and a short concrete ramp, green and grey recycling bins, and large plane trees. Palms and the mountains beyond.

IMG_2364.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: barrel-tile lean-to over a magnolia bed
IMG_2364.HEIC.observation: From a roof edge looking south-east: a mono-pitch roof of lichen-mottled barrel tiles drops beside a tall dense magnolia-like shrub. Beyond: a two-storey white front with arched shuttered windows, a small barrel-tile canopy over a balcony and magenta bougainvillea.

IMG_2365.HEIC.title: Roof by Elena: looking down on the Elena north lane and its planted bed
IMG_2365.HEIC.observation: Almost straight down onto Calle Elena north, looking south-south-east: a straight square-tiled terracotta lane about 1.5 m wide with a narrow white edging kerb. On its left a raised planting bed of tall magnolia-like shrubs edged with strap-leaved plants, ending in a small bed boxed by a clipped hedge. On its right white house walls, a white sill/bench and a first-floor balcony with an iron rail. The lane turns right at the far end by bougainvillea.
